## Fix red main (all three causes)

Main is red for three separate reasons, and each fix was blocked by the other one's red check. This PR carries both, so it can go green on its own.

### Cause 1 — review-run ledger rows merge or double-count (card xrw21vx)
In `scripts/operations/review-pr-io.mjs` the `LEDGER_EVENTS` sink stamped each row with the current ms time and ignored the effect key (`ctx.key`). Since #4498 (b40d36a9f), `ledgerEventId` hashes the whole row (time included) and drops same-id rows. So two runs in the same ms merged into one row (CI `test-shard (2)`: "expected 3 review-run rows, got 2"; ~1 in 10 locally, ~4 of 7 main runs). A replayed idempotent effect got a new time and counted twice.

**Fix:** row id = `review-pr:` + sha256(`ctx.key` + row type). No key → random id. The id is attached after `buildLedgerEvent`, because that function drops `id`.

**Tests (red first):** the existing #3988 test now gives each of its 3 runs its own key, with no sleep. New tests: one effect repeated → 1 row; two runs in one frozen ms → 2 rows; no key → 2 rows. Before the fix 4 failed; after, 203/203 pass.

### Cause 2 — orphan-adopt soak scenario red (card xh6ij2v, from #4522)
Cherry-picked cc531a1ce from `lane/main-red-soak`: `scripts/conveyor/soak/breaks/build-dispatch-orphan-adopt.mjs` now declares its own delivery evidence, so it no longer depends on outside state. This fixes the required `daemon-soak` shard.

**Before/after:** with main's version of the scenario, `build-dispatch-orphan-adopt.soak.test.mjs` fails (`expected [ …(2) ] to deeply equal []`). With this PR it passes.

### Cause 3 — probation-heal-run time bomb (from `lane/hermetic-tests`, card xcu4cqf)
Two describe blocks in `scripts/operations/__tests__/probation-heal-run.test.mjs` polled harness rows dated 2026-10-02 on the real clock. On 2026-10-09 UTC those rows passed `SETTLED_ROW_RETENTION_MS` (7 days), so the poll returned [] (`expected [] to have a length of 100 but got +0`). This PR re-applies only that hunk from 6577028ca: the polls now use the harness clock (`HARNESS_NOW`).

### Proof
- Ledger tests run 20× through the heavy queue, after merging current main: 20/20 pass.
- `probation-heal-run.test.mjs` + `review-pr-io.test.mjs`: 282/282 pass.
- Soak scenario: fails on main's version, passes with this PR.
- `run.mjs verify`: pass.
- Merged origin/main (#4524 landed). Conflicts were in `review-pr-io.mjs` (imports, merged) and `review-pr-io.test.mjs` (kept per-run effect keys, dropped #4524's 3 ms sleep).

### Supersedes #4522
#4522 (`lane/main-red-soak`) is superseded by this PR. **It should be closed after this merges.** It has not been closed here.

### Overlap / override
PR #4524 (WE #5469) held `review-pr-io.mjs` and its test file; the orchestrator overrode this because red main takes priority. #4524 has since landed. This PR removes its 3 ms sleep, which per-run effect keys make unnecessary.

### Other ledger writers with the same time-based id (not fixed, out of scope)
- `scripts/operations/record-referral-ruling-io.mjs` (send-back and ruling events): a replayed effect would append a duplicate row.
- `scripts/merge-ai-prs.mjs` `recordDrainHold`: same pattern, but it already skips a hold with the same reason as the last one, so the risk is low.
